name: Instantly
shortDescription: Cold email outreach. The Growth plan is listed at $47 per month.
longDescription: Instantly's pricing page lists outreach plans, including a Growth plan at $47 per month with unlimited email accounts, and it describes an AI Sales Agent. A higher starter bundle was also listed.
pricingNotes: Pricing page lists an Outreach Growth plan at $47 per month and an AI Sales Agent.

strength: Instantly lists an Outreach Growth plan at $47 per month and describes an AI Sales Agent.
weakness: Higher bundles on the same page cost more, and the page did not promise a free ongoing plan.
